correctness.rationale: The periodic closure appends the least number of zeros making the sum of the two exterior runs divisible by m. When that sum is 1 modulo m, a cyclic period n+j with 0<=j<=m-2 would have total zeros congruent to 1+j-t for t appended ones, a nonzero residue. A shorter-than-word period entails a border. In the special residue case a zero-ended word with zero at both ends can delete its last zero and close cyclically. If endpoints differ, the shortest border v is unbordered, contains a one, and has length at most n/2 (an overlapping border of shortest length k would force a shorter one of length 2k-n). Deleting the final v gives a cyclic closure: the junction gap is the one in the original word that reaches the final copy of v, since its first one is in the same position as in the prefix copy. The zero word has period one. Hence precisely the asserted unbordered words are maximal, including the witness 1^(n-1)0. Reversal exchanges the two orientations. In the 1-to-0 orientation, all words have generating function z^2/(1-z-z^m). A bordered word has unique decomposition vsv with unbordered oriented v; s must run from modular state 1 to 0, first traversing m-1 zeros and then concatenating the loops 1 and 0^m. Conversely such concatenation has shortest border v since a shorter border would border v. This gives the Mahler equation. The whole-language series follows by arbitrary initial/final zero runs and arbitrary intervening 0^(jm)1 blocks. Its dominant root r is simple and unique on its modulus circle by equality in the triangle inequality. U<=A coefficientwise, so its equation continues it into a disk larger than r (chosen smaller than sqrt(r)); its pole at r does not cancel since r^(m-1)U(r^2)<=r^2/2. Taking the ratio of pole coefficients and substituting the equation at r^2 gives the two stated density forms. For the variable modulus, t=m delta satisfies t exp(t)<=m, hence t<=W(m); expanding log(t)+t=log m+O(t^2/m) and using monotonicity gives t~W(m). At r^4 the leading denominator is 4delta+O(delta^2) and the U(r^8) term is bounded after division by O(delta^2) via A(r^8), giving the stated relative correction. Replay: RESULT.md steps 1–5. The frozen checks/verify.py was located and inspected, not executed. An independent bounded enumeration tested all 1,684 admissible words of lengths 2–11 at m=3,4,5,6 by trial of each cyclic completion up to n+m-1, and checked the border criterion and resulting count recurrence there. These finite cases are corroboration only.

evidence: The indexed Perron result gives an exponentially convergent offset law and a Perron–Frobenius border formula for all positive-entropy primitive finite-state Markov shifts. The renewal edge shift here is primitive (cycle plus unit loop). A word with a 1 has a unique edge lift fixed by the state before that symbol, and any binary periodic configuration containing it has a periodic lift of the same least period. All-zero words have m edge lifts rather than one.

Thus the indexed Markov-law hypotheses apply by lifting, even though X_m itself is not an SFT. The frozen citation describes Pannipitiya Prop. 2.27 as giving a mixing SFT bound of n+K-1; it does not supply the exact modular extremal counts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The lift changes only the all-zero word multiplicity by m-1, negligible against exponential word growth, so credit the fixed-m limit-existence mechanism to the general indexed law wherever it applies. Its summary does not state the exact all-length extremizer recurrence and its varying-m asymptotic; whether its full Perron formula includes the same specialization of the limit constant could not be checked. The new contribution is assessed beyond existence or a linear upper bound.

value.rationale: For a natural strictly sofic family the maximum additive delay grows with modulus, whereas the limiting fraction of words attaining it vanishes at a squared-logarithmic scale divided by m^2. An all-length extremizer count and explicit asymptotic quantify this separation, which neither a generic bounded-offset law for fixed input graph nor entropy alone measures. The result does not extrapolate uniform word proportions from the measure of maximal entropy.
